title: Leaving the Title empty shows "Title is a required field" under it
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an open work order, work order 1, that is not invoiced, so you can add a line to it.
  • Start on work order 1, on its Lines tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Line.
  2. Press Tab.
  3. Click the Title box.
  4. Type "Replace tie rod".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Line window opens over work order 1, with the cursor in the empty Title field.

Step 2:

  • The cursor leaves the Title field.
  • "Title is a required field" shows under the Title box (not "Line Name is a required field").
  • The label still reads "Title", at the top of the box, and the grey prompt "What are you doing?" stays inside the box.

Step 3:

  • The cursor is back in the Title field and the message is still shown, because Title is still empty.

Step 4:

  • "Replace tie rod" shows in the Title box.
  • The message "Title is a required field" is gone, because Title is no longer empty.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (Title and Description), Confluence 845348896, version 16 (27 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11257, story SV-10130 (Story 1, The Work Order Line Dialog)

  • S1-R6: “Leaving Title empty blocks the save with the message "Title is a required field", replacing "Line Name is a required field". Every required-field message in the app uses the "X is a required field" form, and this one keeps it. The message shows under the Title box whenever Title is in error, including when the user leaves it empty, the same as every other field in the dialog (SV-10916). A Title longer than 255 characters shows "Title cannot be longer than 255 characters" from the 256th character, replacing "Line name cannot be longer than 255 characters long", and the line cannot be saved while it shows.”
  • S1-R3: “The Title box carries the placeholder "What are you doing?" and the Description box carries "Why are you doing it?". Placeholder text shows while the box is empty and disappears as soon as there is a value. The labels Title and Description always sit at the top of their boxes, empty or filled, with the placeholder underneath; in production the label sat inside the empty box. This is the one layout change in the dialog.”

From: Jira tickets and comments under epic SV-11257, and bug SV-11850 (saved in sources/jira-2026-10-27/ALL-TICKETS-2026-10-27.md), read 27 Oct 2026

  • SV-10130, Nemanja Djuric, 19 Oct 2026 (QA update, PRD v14): “New Line: tab away from the empty Title. "Title is a required field" shows under Title; the label still reads "Title" and the prompt stays inside the box.”

Not yet checked against a build by us: the QA build (sv10130.qa.shopview.com, QuickBooks host qb1.qa.shopview.com) and staging carry this change, and this case has not been run on either.
